Class SimEntity

java.lang.Object
simEngine.SimEntity
Direct Known Subclasses:
NetNode
public abstract class SimEntity extends Object
This class represents entities, or processes, running in the system. To create a new type of entity, it should be extended and a definition for the body() method given. The body() method is called by the SimSystem and defines the behaviour of the entity during the simulation.

Author:
Federico Granata
